description.narrative: Present in Niger since 1992, Oxfam has always supported vulnerable populations affected by natural or man-made disasters in the areas of food security, protection, promotion of water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH), peacebuilding, good governance, and active citizenship. All of Oxfam's interventions in Niger, whether carried out directly or in partnership with local and international organizations, aim to influence and promote social justice and the fight against poverty. In this context of fragility andconflict, Oxfam has capitalized on its field experience in emergency response and development to develop the capacity and expertise to bridge the gap between humanitarian action and resilience. This is achieved through the implementation of disaster riskmanagement mechanisms, advocacy for human rights, and the promotion of social cohesion in a context-sensitive approach, within the framework of its programmaticpillar called the Humanitarian-Development-Peace Nexus Program. Since 2005, Oxfam has been implementing several emergency projects in sites for internally displaced persons, refugee camps, and indigenous communities. With more than 20 years of active presence in Niger, Oxfam has acquired a solid understanding of the local context and carries outhumanitarian operations in the regions of Diffa,Maradi, Tahoua, Tillabéry, and Zinder. Oxfam has a national headquarters in Niamey and three field bases/offices with humanitarian teams active in Diffa, Tillabéri, Maradi, and Zinder. The local partner ADLIhas recognized expertise in humanitarian fields, including protection, food security, vulnerability monitoring, and EHA. As part of their collaboration, Oxfam supports ADLI in the technical implementation, monitoring, and quality assurance of interventions. This partnership is part of a strategy to strengthen local capacities and consolidate a contextualized, inclusive, and coordinated response to humanitarian crises in Niger.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib is one of the 17 national affiliates of the Oxfam International Confederation. It started life in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Working together in confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education for all, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam Novibs main office is based in The Netherlands, it supports the work of a network of local offices, the implementation of global projects, fund raising, campaigning and advocacy. The Hub Niamey Niger exists since 2006 as a humanitarian field office and since 2012 as the decentralized Country office for Oxfam Novib, dealing with all the development and humanitarian themes like Sustainable livelihoods, Right to Basic services, Humanitarian and resilience interventions, The right to be heard and the right to an Identity, including women's rights and sexual and reproductive health rights. The Country Office in Niger works with local partners to realize the vision of a Niger without poverty
